development_forecast.forecast_methodology: Exploratory Scenario Simulation (Biopharmaceutical Literature Benchmarks: DiMasi et al., Hay et al.)
development_forecast.pathway_explanation: Candidate 'RITONAVIR' has documented Phase 1 first-in-human safety trials specifically for 'Malaria'.
development_forecast.window_type: Illustrative Duration Sensitivity Spread (+/- 30-35% Historical Trial Variance; Not a Calibrated ML Confidence Interval)
development_forecast.therapeutic_transferability_assessment: Phenotypic symptom similarity (Jaccard = 0.6250) reflects clinical symptom overlap, NOT biological or target homology. Efficacy against an emerging disease depends on pathogen etiology, target engagement, and host response. The historical pipeline success rate (11.0%) is an industry benchmark under sequential trial conditions, not a validated probability of clinical transfer.

baseline.scenario_description: Conventional drug development adhering strictly to historical DiMasi / Hay median durations with traditional trial protocols.

moderate.scenario_description: 15% duration reduction in discovery and Phase 1-2 via automated phenotypic screening and genomic biomarker patient stratification.

aggressive.scenario_name: Aggressive AI & Adaptive Platform Acceleration (Breakthrough Paradigm)
aggressive.scenario_description: 30% duration reduction via generative de novo molecular design, in-silico ADMET toxicity modeling, and multi-arm adaptive platform trial designs.

data_limitations: Projections are scenario-based arithmetic simulations using historical literature benchmarks (DiMasi/Hay), NOT a trained ML time-series forecast.
Efficacy against the emerging disease is an unverified computational hypothesis; symptom similarity does not imply biological target overlap.
Sensitivity windows reflect illustrative duration dispersion (+/- 30-35%), NOT calibrated statistical prediction intervals.
Clinical trial failure / safety attrition rates historically exceed 80-85% across exploratory biopharmaceutical development.
Accelerated technological progress scenarios (15% and 30% speedup) are hypothetical exploratory what-if assumptions, not measured AI effects.
development_forecast.selection_rationale: Selected highest symptom match 'Malaria' (Jaccard = 0.6250). Evaluated 3 viable candidate(s).
